items.title: 52115_Danny Barker oral history interview
items.q: He told Paul in the evening, he said, 'There's a guy who spoke to me today, whose name is McKinney. He asked me if I want to join his band and go on to Detroit.'

ctx.x: But Simon upset the Rhythm Club. So he came back, he said... He told Paul in the evening, he said, "There's a guy who spoke to me today, whose name is McKinney. He asked me if I want to join his band and go on to Detroit." Paul said, "Do you know who McKinney is?"
